decision: Retain all evidence and both r1 T16 candidates for further comparison; do not replace frozen ANN, claim lossless conversion/energy savings, start training, or implement other directions.
findings: Same-pool task rescoring improves r1 T16 Dev IoU, but recall, especially HD recall, decreases versus ANN.
Further task search improves r2 T4/T16 IoU versus same-T uncalibrated; both require more AC. T8 reduces AC but loses IoU.
r2 T4 matched-AC has a material recall loss; it is not an acceptable lossless replacement.
The highest sampled calibration objective need not generalize best to Dev; the finite shared-layer parameter search does not establish global optimality.
Proposal and first-layer MAC remain; unweighted MAC+AC and software counts are not measured energy.
